column2: Appoint local officials to bring basic order and record-keeping to the provinces.
Rational, positivist administration is the mark of a modern state -- establish provincial ministries across the realm.
Replace patronage appointments with a merit-based civil service, examined and trained in the new social sciences.
The age of mass politics demands a modern state to match it -- electrified, telephoned, and thoroughly bureaucratic.
New government offices have been established, and the machinery of the state reorganizes itself accordingly.
